dataIdInfo.idPurp: ArcGIS Pro geoprocessing tools by Jenness Enterprises, organized into themed sub-toolboxes (toolsets).
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
Jenness Enterprises Tools is an ArcGIS Pro Python toolbox of geoprocessing tools developed by Jeff Jenness (Jenness Enterprises). Tools are grouped into sub-toolboxes (toolsets) by theme, and all are usable in ModelBuilder and the Geoprocessing pane.

Wildlife and Forestry Tools toolset: wildlife home-range and movement-analysis tools, beginning with the Local Convex Hull (LoCoH) family of home-range and utilization-distribution estimators.

Additional toolsets and tools will be added over time.
